title: Porsche UK brochure: the 911 Turbo (993), WVK 142 020, dated 2/95
publisher: Dr. Ing. h.c. F. Porsche AG; community archive
notes: Marketing brochure for the German-specification models shown, UK edition (colophon: date 2/95, WVK 142 020, first edition 4,500). 27-page scan whose text layer is unreadable; the Technical Specifications spread (PDF page 22) was read on the rendered image on 2026-11-20. It gives kerb weight 1,500 kg, maximum weight 1,840 kg, maximum front axle load 760 kg, maximum rear axle load 1,150 kg and a 240 mm double-mass flywheel. The weighing standard behind the kerb weight is not stated. It gives no engine weight: no Porsche document reached so far gives the M64/60 engine mass (issue #434, docs/research/993-engine-mass-scope-20261120.md).
